agendaGuardrails: Preserve methodology 1.0, T0 evidence/provenance/causal gates, immutable history and the Decision Ladder.
Learning may change routing, search strategy, ownership, retry policy and health judgments; it may never weaken truth gates to manufacture progress.
Activity is not progress. A fresh receipt with zero closure while backlog remains is a warning signal, not a healthy outcome.
Close the nearest lawful frontier before opening unnecessary new surface area.

activeLessons.symptom: packet_ready remained blocked while Alpha reported missing source-addressed scoring inputs and Deep Resolver retried the same downstream gating symptoms.
activeLessons.rootCause: Source acquisition and numeric evidence construction belonged to Council Alpha; Resolver was consuming downstream symptoms before the root owner had closed them.
activeLessons.failedStrategy: Repeatedly re-inspecting existing cumulative lineage and returning unavailable without materially different source acquisition.
activeLessons.correctiveAction: Council Alpha actively acquires missing primary/current sources and builds source-addressed factor/risk/confidence evidence. Deep Resolver defers gating issue/unknown symptoms while another owner has concrete root-cause failures, unless a material contradiction independently requires adjudication.
activeLessons.successSignal: packet_ready converts to chief_ready or the blocker changes to a genuinely external/methodology decision with documented attempted source paths.
activeLessons.guardrail: Never invent numeric values or weaken score/provenance requirements.

activeLessons.symptom: Workgraph could report healthy while canonical progress was stale for hours and a worker produced a fresh zero-closure receipt.
activeLessons.rootCause: Health emphasized timestamp freshness more than state conversion.
activeLessons.failedStrategy: Treating recent run receipts as sufficient proof of productivity.
activeLessons.correctiveAction: Health must flag a stalled packet frontier and recent zero-closure runs with owned backlog. Chief must investigate and change the resolution path before the next identical cycle.
activeLessons.successSignal: frontier state advances, blocker signature changes with new evidence, or a precise external decision is escalated.
activeLessons.guardrail: Do not fake progress by promoting incomplete packets.

activeLessons.symptom: Learning currentSignals retained 57 canonical and 2 chief_ready while same-cycle post-promotion metrics reported 59 canonical and 0 chief_ready and fast-path recorded two lawful promotions.
activeLessons.rootCause: Learning/Shadow projection was generated before deterministic fast-path promotion and was not refreshed after the canonical transition.
activeLessons.failedStrategy: Treating same-cycle advisory/learning snapshots as authoritative after a later Core promotion phase.
activeLessons.correctiveAction: Use the newest post-promotion Core metrics and fast-path report for command decisions; regenerate or phase-label learning projections after deterministic promotion so stale pre-promotion frontier state cannot masquerade as current truth.
activeLessons.successSignal: After a promotion cycle, learning currentSignals matches post-promotion Core counts or explicitly declares its pre-promotion phase and does not emit stale frontier alerts.
activeLessons.guardrail: Never let learning or Shadow state override newer Earth Core canonical state.

virtualLanePolicy.principle: five permanent intelligent supervisors; queued companies/exceptions are virtual work lanes, not one automation each
rules: Packet-ready/chief-ready closure consumes capacity before opening more surface area.
A tasker may process multiple independent queue items in one run within its bounded execution budget.
When the frontier is stalled, workers spend the next run changing resolution strategy rather than repeating the prior attempt.
GitHub Actions performs deterministic reconcile/promotion/publication reactions so intelligent task slots are reserved for judgment and evidence work.
No virtual lane may bypass methodology, source provenance, causal proof, Beast integrity or immutable-history requirements.
